positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Facilitated the automation process of opening vendor tickets through log scraping
- Consolidated server failure data and created visualizations through Logstash and Kibana
- Navigated through Linux environment and created Perl and Python scripts
- Developed a Flask API that returns relevant subnet information needed for system landings
- Deployed micro services into Kubernetes clusters using gitlab and Helm 
- Maintained and troubleshot servers in data centers 
- Trained new interns and helped with the onboarding process
- Facilitated daily standup meetings with interns and meetings to address HPC change requests
